children: South Korea’s imports jumped 26.0% year-on-year in September 2026, accelerating from a 22.4% increase in the previous month and beating market forecasts of 21.5%, flash data showed.
It was the 11th consecutive month of import growth, reflected solid domestic demand, with strong semiconductor-related imports continued to support overall trade activity.

title: South Korea Import Growth Tops Estimates
